In October 2022, six of us said "health care costs," six said "the social security," and six said "clean school bus." Five of us said "clean school bus program," five said "cost-of-living adjustment cola," and five said "for generations to come." Five of us reached for "infrastructure investment and jobs act." Five of us said "forward to continuing to."

Peter Welch first said "health care costs," in 2013. John B. Larson first said "forward to continuing to," in 2013. The phrase "the social security" we traced to 2013, first spoken by Tim Walberg. "Infrastructure investment and jobs act" we traced to 2021, first spoken by Lisa Murkowski.

We recorded no phrase said by more than six of us in this era. We report the counts as we find them. This was the shape of our repetition in that month, and we set it down without addition.
